 EvalCaseImportClaim:
 type: object
 description: >-
 What a converter CLAIMED about one imp
orted case. `exact` is\n CONVERTER-CLAIMED exact — the converter says it applied a structural\n mapping rule, cited
in `note`. MCPJam has NOT verified semantic\n equivalence, so user-facing copy must say \"claimed exact\", never\n \
"verified\" or \"accepted\". Claim-only: who approved an approximation,\n when, and why is a PER-RUN decision frozen on the
run\n (`ImportEligibility.approvedApproximationReceipts`), never stored on the\n case — an approval that lived on a
case would outlive the run it was\n granted for and the edit that invalidated it. Approval and internal keys\n are

rejected with 400, never stripped.
 required:
 - status
 additionalProperties: false
 properties:

status:
 type: string
 enum:
 - exact
 - approximated
 - unsupported

- unresolved
 description: >-
 `exact`: the converter claims a 1:1 structural mapping, and must
cite it in `note`. `approximated`: behaviour was intentionally\n approximated; a human must approve it for
EVERY run. `unsupported`:\n the source behaviour cannot currently be represented. `unresolved`:\n a determin
istic reference does not resolve against the live target.\n A selected `unsupported` or `unresolved` case cannot run.\n

sourceCaseKey:
 type: string
 minLength: 1
 maxLength: 512
 description: The case'

s identity in the source system, when it had one.
 note:
 type: string
 minLength: 1
 maxLen

gth: 2000
 description: >-
 Why the status is what it is — the mapping rule cited, or what was

lost. REQUIRED when `status` is `exact`.
 EvalCaseSource:
 type: object
 description: >-
 Where an AI-assi
sted Markdown case was authored from. Provenance only:\n the file, its hash, and the line range the extractor read, so a re
ader\n can trace a case back to its source document. It is not an import claim\n (see `EvalCaseImportClaim`) and car

ries no approval semantics.
 required:
 - format
 - method
 - fileName
 - fileHash

- excerpt
 - startLine
 - endLine
 - extractorVersion
 additionalProperties: false
 properties

:
 format:
 type: string
 enum:
 - markdown
 method:
 type: string

enum:
 - ai
 description: >-
 How the case was derived from the document. `ai`: an extract

or model
 proposed it and a person reviewed it before it was saved.

 type: string

minLength: 1
 maxLength: 255

description: SHA-256 of the source document, lowercase hex.

maxLength: 102400
 description: The passage the case was extracted from.

nteger
 minimum: 1
 endLine:

 minimum: 1
 description: Inclusive; n

ever less than `startLine`.

 type: string
 minLength: 1
 maxLength: 100
